message.content: {"rules":[{"id":"r1","text":"If the horizontal positions encode progression through the displayed reporting period from left to right, the vertical axis labeled \"Count\" is encoded by its printed tick values despite their increase downward on the page, and the route whose label names rising-case escalation is the pathway for an increasing reported-case trajectory, then a line moving from near the 0 tick at the left toward values beyond the 1400 tick at the right supports that escalation route.","component":"encoding/task relation","conditions":"The printed Count-axis inscriptions accurately define the vertical value direction;
